summary: Return a fresh descriptor object for an own property without invoking that property's getter.

semantics.descriptor: fresh object containing data or accessor fields plus enumerable/configurable
semantics.getter_invocation: the described getter is not called

caveats: Requires property-attribute metadata absent from ordinary C# fields/properties.
Proxy getOwnPropertyDescriptor traps require runtime invariants.

tests.name: getter not invoked
tests.input: let n=0; const x={get a(){n++;return 1}}; const d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(x,'a'); console.log(typeof d.get,n);
